evidence.quote: Therefore, the agencies this morning announced that we do not expect that any of the proposed rules would become effective on January 1, 2013.
I am convinced that the best course for policymakers would be to abandon efforts for a one-size-fits-all approach to mortgage lending.
So it seems to me that appropriate policy should encourage community banks to expand their mortgage lending rather than discourage them from doing so.

parsed.rationale: The speech addresses bank capital regulation and community bank mortgage lending, not monetary policy. It offers no view on rates, inflation, the economic outlook, or the Fed's balance sheet, so the stance is neutral.
